sections: P6 — Cut author, skill, setup, and doctor paths

repo_truth: The exact shipped profile 1.1, canonical Charter, common intake evaluator, lifecycle core, runtime-vector validator, and authenticator/approver service core are present with focused tests green. A separate concurrent lane owns filesystem promotion transactions. This lane owns thin compiler/CLI/skill/setup/doctor product adapters only.
allowed_scope: Edit compiler, CLI, generated/core/install skill and Charter template assets, setup/doctor adapters, their focused tests and fixtures, and narrowly required public DTO/export surfaces.
Replace selected legacy Markdown authoring with exact author/approve/promote/validate and approvers grammar while preserving typed fail-closed behavior when a promotion service is unavailable.
Keep setup non-authoring and derive doctor fields from one retained engine observation; preserve Project Context and unrelated readiness semantics.
Use RED tests first and run with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=D:\codex-build\handbook-hcm22 and TEMP/TMP=D:\codex-temp\handbook-hcm22.
Run GitNexus impact before every existing function/class/method edit; report and pause for parent authorization before HIGH or CRITICAL edits.
non_goals: Do not edit engine definition/schema/profile/security/transaction internals, flow, Environment Inventory content, proof/control, planning, handoff, ledger, or dispatch files.
Do not add a nested CLI questionnaire, an LLM/model call, direct canonical YAML/Markdown write, self-approval/promotion, software authenticator fallback, or HCM-2.3.
Do not commit or create handoffs, ledger rows, dispatches, or user-visible task hops.
tasks: Read the complete dispatch, exact P6/product/API authority, live compiler/CLI/skill/setup/doctor paths, and engine public APIs.

Write RED tests for exact command grammar and mappings, JSON/human refused/success projections, validate-only behavior, no selected legacy input, conflicting legacy irrelevance, setup non-authoring, doctor additive observation, and generated/install equality.
Run and report GitNexus impact for every existing seam; pause on HIGH/CRITICAL before editing.
After parent authorization, implement the smallest thin adapters and skill changes and return focused GREEN evidence plus any missing transaction API needed from the concurrent lane.
contracts_and_gates: Compiler/CLI accept caller intent only and never duplicate semantic validation, authority selection, cryptographic verification, or transaction recovery.
Author produces immutable intake/candidate lineage only; approve and promote cannot silently succeed without native authority and exact transaction services; validate is non-mutating.
Legacy --from-inputs without --mode, direct Markdown authoring, and interactive wizard behavior refuse with typed next actions and have zero selected-path influence.
Setup does not author Charter truth; doctor remains additive and uses one retained observation.
stop_conditions: Pause and report before any HIGH or CRITICAL existing-symbol edit.
Return blocked rather than inventing missing engine transaction semantics or a weaker fallback.
Return blocked if installed/core/generated skill equality cannot be preserved within named assets.
